Description:
Goal: Define the mission, MVP goal, non-goals, success criteria, constraints, and completion definition.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Project charter exists in docs/project_charter.md
- MVP and non-goals are explicit
- Success criteria are testable

Output Artifact: docs/project_charter.md

Goal: Create the Jira project and import this MVP backlog.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Project named Local Scriptorium exists
- Board has Backlog, Selected for Sprint, In Progress, Blocked, Review, Done
- Story points and original estimate are visible

Output Artifact: Jira board URL or screenshot

Goal: Create a simple project workspace with folders for sources, chunks, outputs, evals, docs, decisions, and scripts.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Folder structure exists
- README stub exists
- No extra framework added yet

Output Artifact: Repo/folder screenshot or README

Goal: Create a reusable decision log for technical and product decisions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- decision_log.md exists
- Template includes date, context, options, decision, reason, consequences
- First decision recorded

Output Artifact: decisions/decision_log.md

Goal: Confirm the imported backlog is usable and estimates are visible.

Acceptance Criteria:
- CSV import completed
- Ticket descriptions preserved
- Estimates mapped or documented as custom fields

Output Artifact: Screenshot or short setup note

Goal: Install Ollama locally as the easiest baseline for local inference.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Ollama installed
- Terminal command works
- Install notes saved

Output Artifact: docs/setup_notes.md

Goal: Run a small local LLM and produce the first local answer.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Model pulled
- Prompt returns output
- Model name and command saved

Output Artifact: outputs/local_model_hello_world.md

Goal: Create a small prompt set for comparing local and cloud answers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- 10 prompts written
- Prompts cover summary, argument extraction, evidence, uncertainty, and refusal
- Prompts saved in evals folder

Output Artifact: evals/baseline_prompts.md

Goal: Run the baseline prompts through the local model and save outputs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- All 10 prompts run locally
- Outputs saved with model name and date
- Obvious failures noted

Output Artifact: outputs/baseline_local_outputs.md

Goal: Run the same prompts through ChatGPT and compare quality, latency, and structure.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Same prompt set used
- Local vs cloud differences recorded
- At least 3 failure examples captured

Output Artifact: docs/local_vs_cloud_comparison.md

Goal: Summarize what local inference means in practice after first hands-on testing.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Memo explains what worked
- Memo explains what failed
- Memo identifies next smallest step

Output Artifact: docs/day_1_local_inference_baseline.md

Goal: Choose the first 3 to 5 clean text sources for the MVP corpus.

Acceptance Criteria:
- 3 to 5 sources selected
- Sources are text or markdown
- Copyright/privacy status noted

Output Artifact: sources/source_selection.md

Goal: Create metadata for each source so chunks can be traced back later.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Metadata includes source_id, title, author, type, notes
- Every source has a stable ID
- File saved in sources folder

Output Artifact: sources/sources_metadata.csv

Goal: Prepare source files by removing obvious formatting junk and making text usable.

Acceptance Criteria:
- 3 files cleaned
- Headings preserved where useful
- Cleaned files saved separately

Output Artifact: sources/clean/

Goal: Create a stable ID convention for chunks.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Convention documented
- Example chunk IDs included
- IDs encode source and sequence

Output Artifact: docs/chunking_rules.md

Goal: Manually chunk one source to understand the desired structure before scripting.

Acceptance Criteria:
- At least 20 chunks created
- Each chunk has source ID
- Chunks are readable and not overly tiny

Output Artifact: chunks/manual_chunks.md

Summary: Create chunking script with AI coding tool
Description:
Goal: Use an AI coding assistant to create a simple script that chunks txt and markdown files.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Script reads sources folder
- Script writes chunks.json
- Script preserves source filename and source ID
- Script prints chunk count

Output Artifact: scripts/chunk_sources.py and chunks/chunks.json

Goal: Check that automated chunks are coherent and traceable.

Acceptance Criteria:
- 10 random chunks inspected
- Bad chunk examples logged
- Chunking rules updated if needed

Output Artifact: docs/chunk_validation_notes.md

Goal: Create questions that require source-grounded answers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- 10 questions written
- Questions include factual, interpretive, and comparison types
- Expected source hints added where possible

Output Artifact: evals/manual_rag_questions.md

Goal: Pick source chunks by hand for each manual RAG question.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Each question has selected chunk IDs
- Selection rationale noted
- At least one insufficient-evidence case included

Output Artifact: evals/manual_rag_contexts.md

Summary: Run prompts with and without chunks
Description:
Goal: Compare local answers with and without supplied context.

Acceptance Criteria:
- All 10 questions run both ways
- Outputs saved
- Differences highlighted

Output Artifact: outputs/manual_rag_comparison.md

Goal: Write what manual RAG improved and where it still failed.

Acceptance Criteria:
- At least 3 improvements documented
- At least 3 failures documented
- Decision made on retrieval approach for MVP

Output Artifact: docs/manual_rag_findings.md

Goal: Create a simple retrieval baseline using keyword or lexical search.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Script accepts a question
- Script searches chunks.json
- Script returns candidate chunks

Output Artifact: scripts/search_chunks.py

Summary: Return top 5 chunks for a question
Description:
Goal: As a user, I can ask a question and see the top 5 retrieved source chunks.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Question input supported
- Top 5 chunks displayed with source IDs
- Output is readable

Output Artifact: outputs/sample_retrieval_output.md

Summary: Log retrieved chunks to output file
Description:
Goal: Save retrieval results so they can be evaluated later.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Results saved to outputs folder
- Includes question, timestamp, chunk IDs, scores if available
- File format is reusable

Output Artifact: outputs/retrieval_log.json or md

Goal: Run retrieval on a broader set of questions and inspect quality.

Acceptance Criteria:
- 15 questions tested
- Correct/incorrect retrieval noted
- Failure examples saved

Output Artifact: evals/retrieval_test_results.md

Goal: Create the strict prompt template that forces sourced, cautious answers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Template says use only provided sources
- Template requires source IDs
- Template includes uncertainty and insufficient evidence section

Output Artifact: docs/grounded_answer_prompt.md

Summary: Connect retrieval output to model input
Description:
Goal: As a user, retrieved chunks are passed into the local model as answer context.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Retrieval output becomes model context
- Prompt template applied
- Command documented

Output Artifact: scripts/answer_with_context.py

Summary: Generate grounded answer with source IDs
Description:
Goal: As a user, I receive an answer that cites the source chunks it used.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Answer includes source IDs
- Answer is based on retrieved chunks
- Output saved

Output Artifact: outputs/sample_grounded_answer.md

Summary: Add uncertainty and insufficient evidence section
Description:
Goal: Make the model explicitly state uncertainty and source limitations.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Output includes uncertainty section
- Output includes what sources do not establish
- At least one refusal/insufficient evidence example tested

Output Artifact: outputs/insufficient_evidence_example.md

Summary: Save generated answers to outputs folder
Description:
Goal: Ensure generated answers are saved consistently for review and case study evidence.

Acceptance Criteria:
- File naming convention exists
- Question, sources, model, and answer are saved
- At least 5 sample answers saved

Output Artifact: outputs/grounded_answers/

Goal: Create a compact evaluation set for MVP quality testing.

Acceptance Criteria:
- 20 questions created
- Expected answer traits included
- Questions cover factual, interpretive, comparison, and insufficient evidence cases

Output Artifact: evals/mvp_eval_set.csv

Goal: Define how outputs will be judged.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Rubric includes retrieval correctness
- Rubric includes hallucination/unsupported claim check
- Rubric includes usefulness score

Output Artifact: evals/scoring_rubric.md

Summary: Run mini eval local only vs local RAG
Description:
Goal: Compare local model answers with and without retrieval.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Same questions run in both modes
- Scores recorded
- At least 5 failures inspected

Output Artifact: evals/mvp_eval_results.csv

Goal: Categorize the failure modes seen during evaluation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Failure categories defined
- Examples included
- Mitigations proposed

Output Artifact: docs/failure_taxonomy.md

Goal: Write a concise eval report that can be used in the portfolio case study.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Summary includes what worked
- Summary includes what failed
- Summary includes next improvements

Output Artifact: docs/mvp_eval_summary.md

Goal: Attempt to install Tether's QVAC SDK and document setup.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Installation attempted
- Commands captured
- Blockers documented if install fails

Output Artifact: docs/qvac_setup_notes.md

Summary: Run QVAC hello world or capture blocker
Description:
Goal: Try a minimal local completion with QVAC or capture why it could not run.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Hello-world completion attempted
- Output saved or blocker documented
- No MVP dependency created

Summary: Write QVAC vs Ollama comparison memo
Description:
Goal: Compare QVAC and Ollama from an implementation/product perspective.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Setup difficulty compared
- Developer experience compared
- Recommendation for MVP+1 recorded

Output Artifact: docs/qvac_vs_ollama.md

Goal: Create a concise product brief for Local Scriptorium.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Problem, user, use cases, non-goals, success metrics included
- Brief understandable to nontechnical reader
- Limitations stated

Output Artifact: docs/product_brief.md

Goal: Create a simple architecture diagram showing data flow and local/cloud boundaries.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Diagram shows sources, chunking, retrieval, local model, output, eval
- Local boundary is explicit
- Diagram included in README or docs

Output Artifact: docs/architecture_diagram.png or md

Goal: Document implementation and product risks.

Acceptance Criteria:
- At least 8 risks listed
- Each risk has mitigation
- Privacy, hallucination, retrieval, and hardware constraints included

Output Artifact: docs/risk_register.md

Goal: Write the main portfolio case study.

Acceptance Criteria:
- README explains mission, architecture, demo workflow, eval, failures, and next steps
- README avoids overclaiming
- README includes sample outputs

Output Artifact: README.md

Summary: Create final demo script and screenshots
Description:
Goal: Prepare a repeatable demo and capture evidence.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Demo script has exact commands
- Screenshots or output examples saved
- MVP completion criteria checked
